ceiling_directive: Construct sensitivity-one full-fiber scores on the exact-uniform Hölder class and prove a nuisance-dimension-independent weighted-shell bound uniformly across sparse and dense occupancy, thereby establishing the matching upper rate.
improvement_directive: Resolve the full-fiber occupancy lift by explicitly constructing the score family and proving its uniform weighted-shell certificate. Combining that result with the existing selector reduction would turn the current converse into a same-class minimax frontier.
critique: The delivered contribution is a one-sided pure-DP lower bound with the new sparse two-fiber term, plus an elementary occupancy-score identity and an upward transfer to a larger lower-bound class. It does not deliver the advertised sparse-to-dense minimax frontier because the full-class estimator and matching upper bound are entirely conditional on the unresolved full-fiber occupancy lift. The superclass transfer adds no achievability result, and the occupancy identity alone does not control profiling over the unknown propensity and outcome-regression fibers. The framing explicitly discloses this limitation rather than falsely claiming a match, but the missing estimator, unresolved nuisance-dimension control, and absence of supporting application evidence keep the package below a field-level contribution and constrain the projected paper score. [D0.5.G projected paper-score gate: paper_score_ceiling 5 < 7.2, so the graded tier 'subfield' is capped at 'incremental'. The score assesses the delivered research package without credit for unfinished work.]
